data.subject: Re: Vendor shortlist for the Q4 RFP
data.body:
Hi Marcus,

On Sept 9 you said you'd "get me the full vendor list by end of day Friday". That commitment is now 12 days overdue. On Sept 22 you reported "Sending over what I have so far: eleven of the thirteen vendors, attached. Still chasing Delacroix Freight and Halvorsen Group, their paperwork is stuck with our legal team. I will get you those two by Thursday." Yet the remaining two vendors are still missing. Please provide a firm date by which you will deliver the outstanding items.

Thanks,
Sam
